name: Query Sage X3 in natural language with an AI agent and an MCP server

parameters.content:
## Query Sage X3 in natural language

An AI agent that answers sales and supply chain questions asked in plain English, by querying the Sage X3 database directly. The same tools are exposed as an **MCP server**, so they can also be used from Claude, Cursor or any other MCP client.

### Who it is for

ADV, sales, supply chain and controlling teams who work on Sage X3 and lose time asking for extracts, and X3 integrators who want to add a conversational layer without building an API.

### The problem it solves

Answering "how many of this item are left", "what is my 2025 billed revenue by customer" or "what does this customer actually buy from me" normally takes a SQL query, an extract or a ticket. Here the question is asked in plain English and the answer comes back in seconds.

### What it does

1. Receives the question through the n8n chat.
2. The agent picks the right SQL tool, or tools, out of 14.
3. Each tool runs a parameterised query on Sage X3, with the filters applied at call time.
4. Internal X3 codes (local menus) and item descriptions are resolved to text directly in SQL, through APLSTD and ATEXTRA.
5. The agent writes up the answer, stating currency and horizon.

### The 14 tools

**Reference data** - customer search, item search (short), full item record, customer item cross-reference.
**Stock** - available by site, detail by lot and location, movements in detail and aggregated.
**Sales orders** - line history, full read, creation.
**Revenue** - one aggregate tool driven by a granularity parameter, and two detail tools (billed, ordered).

The split follows a single rule: **one aggregate to quantify, one detail to explain**. No tool overlaps another.

### Watch out for

- Order creation really writes into Sage X3. It is exposed on the MCP server: any client holding the token can call it without going through the confirmation rule of the system prompt. Remove that node from the MCP if you do not need it.
- Revenue covers billed and ordered. Forecast is not exposed: the Sage X3 ORDERS table mixes replenishment suggestions with open sales order lines, with no reliable business partner and no usable valuation.
- The queries are written in **T-SQL (Microsoft SQL Server)**. On Oracle, ISNULL, string concatenation and CAST have to be adapted.

## Set this up before use

### 1. Install the community node

This workflow depends on the **`n8n-nodes-nx3`** package, which provides the Sage X3 SOAP connector. Without it, the 14 tools will not appear.

Settings > Community nodes > Install > `n8n-nodes-nx3`

### 2. Create the credentials

- **Nx3 SOAP API**: Sage X3 SOAP server URL, folder, user, password. To be selected on the 14 tool nodes.
- **Bearer Auth**: on the MCP node, to protect the endpoint. Generate a token with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
- **OpenRouter**: API key on the language model node. Any compatible provider will do.

### 3. Replace the placeholder values

| Where | Value | Replace with |
|---|---|---|
| `x3_sales_order_create` | `YOUR_X3_USER` | The X3 user code the orders are created under |
| MCP node | path `sage-x3-mcp` | Any path you like |

### 4. Test it

Activate the workflow, open the chat and ask: *"list my customers in category FR"*, then *"what is my billed revenue by month for 2025"*. If the first question answers and the second returns amounts in euros, the whole chain works.

### Language of the X3 labels

Local menus and item descriptions are read in English (`LAN_0='ENG'`, `LANGUE_0='ENG'`). If your folder does not hold the English translations, replace `'ENG'` with your own language code in the SQL of the tool nodes.

## 1. Conversation interface

The n8n chat receives the question, the agent picks the tools, and the memory keeps the thread so follow-up questions work ("and for 2026?").

The agent system prompt carries most of the logic: routing across the 14 tools.

## 2. MCP exposure

The same 14 tools are published on an MCP endpoint, usable from Claude, Cursor or any compatible client.

Protected by Bearer Auth. Careful: order creation is exposed there with no confirmation guard.

## 3. Reference data - turn a name into a code

Every question that quotes a name comes through here first. The agent turns "Urban Cycle" into `FR001` and "adult bike" into `FIN008` before querying orders, stock or revenue.

`x3_item_search` returns 10 columns and is there to **find** an item. `x3_item_detail` returns the full record, around sixty columns, and is there to **read** the setup of an item that is already identified. The fourth tool covers the case where the customer uses their own item reference.

Item descriptions are resolved from **ATEXTRA** (`CODFIC_0='ITMMASTER'`, `ZONE_0='DES1AXX'`, `LANGUE_0='ENG'`), falling back to `ITMDES1_0` when no translation exists. Search by description queries both the base language and the translation.

## 4. Stock - levels and movements

`x3_stock_available` answers "how much is left", by site. The figure to quote is `STOCK_AVAILABLE`, which removes allocations: it is not `STOCK_TOTAL`.

`x3_stock_detail` answers "where is the stock, which lots". The two movement tools cover the journal detail and the aggregated volumes over a period.

## 5. Sales orders

History of ordered lines, full read of one order from its number, and creation.

For **what is left to deliver** rather than what was ordered, use `x3_revenue_ordered` in section 6.

**Creation really writes into Sage X3.** The system prompt requires an explicit confirmation before the call, but that rule only applies to the conversational path, not to direct MCP calls.

## 6. Revenue - one aggregate, two details

`x3_revenue_summary` is the entry point: it aggregates on the database side, converts to euros through `TABCHANGE` at the daily rate, and its **`level`** parameter picks the granularity - `Total`, `Month`, `Customer`, `Item` or `CustomerItem`. On its own it answers any total, ranking, trend or period comparison.

`x3_revenue_billed` and `x3_revenue_ordered` are only there to explain a figure already obtained, each with the columns specific to its horizon: document type and shipment site for billed, net price and delivered, invoiced, allocated and short quantities for the order book.

The business sign follows `TABSIVTYP.INVTYP_0`: credit memos and credit notes negative, proformas at zero. The `LINES_WITHOUT_RATE` column flags the lines whose currency has no exchange rate: their amount is excluded from the total.

**No forecast.** The `ORDERS` table mixes replenishment suggestions with no business partner and open lines coming from sales orders, which would double count against the order book. It is not exposed.

options.systemMessage:
You are a sales and supply chain analyst working on Sage X3. You answer only from the data returned by your tools.

## Choosing the right tool

Reference data, to resolve a name into a code before any other query:
- x3_customer_search: customers. Customer name to BPCNUM_0 code.
- x3_item_search: items, short answer. Description to ITMREF_0 reference. This is the default item entry point.
- x3_item_detail: full item record. Only for a setup question about an item that is already identified.
- x3_customer_product: mapping between the X3 reference and the customer's own reference, when the customer quotes an unknown reference.

Stock:
- x3_stock_available: how much is left, by site. The figure to quote is STOCK_AVAILABLE.
- x3_stock_detail: where the stock is, which lots, what sits in quality control.
- x3_stock_movements_summary: inbound and outbound volumes over a period.
- x3_stock_movements: movement detail, only when the detail is asked for.

Sales orders:
- x3_sales_order_lines: history of ordered lines, ordered quantities.
- x3_sales_order_read: full read of one order from its exact number.
- x3_sales_order_create: creation. Irreversible write.

Revenue:
- x3_revenue_summary: ALWAYS FIRST. Totals converted to euros, with a level parameter that picks the granularity: Total, Month, Customer, Item, CustomerItem. On its own it answers any total, ranking, trend or period comparison.
- x3_revenue_billed: billed revenue detail, the actuals.
- x3_revenue_ordered: order book detail, what is left to deliver.

There is no forecast revenue tool: do not invent one, and say the data is not available when the question is about sales forecasts.

Routing rule: a total or a ranking goes through an aggregate tool (x3_revenue_summary, x3_stock_movements_summary, x3_stock_available). Detail tools only explain a figure that has already been obtained. Never sum detail lines yourself.

## Tool response format

SQL tools return an object { rowCount, columns, rows } where rows is an array of arrays. Map each value to its name through columns, in order. Never assume the column order without reading columns.

## Call rules

1. Never add single quotes or % characters around filter values. The tools add them themselves. Write FIN008 and not 'FIN008', write Bike and not %Bike%.
2. Multi-value filters are separated by a comma with no space: FR001,FR002. Filters of the same tool combine with AND.
3. Filter at call time and always bound the dates when the question covers a period.
4. On x3_revenue_summary, always fill in level. Without it the five granularities come back mixed together and the result is unusable. Columns outside the requested level are NULL, that is expected.
5. Resolve names into codes before querying orders, stock or revenue.
6. Never add up amounts in different currencies. Use REVENUE_EUR or AMOUNT_EUR when the column exists. A EUR_RATE of zero flags a missing exchange rate: the euro amount is wrong in that case, say so.
7. If rowCount reaches the cap announced by the tool, say the result is truncated and offer a narrower filter instead of concluding.
8. An empty result (rowCount 0) means no data, not an error. Check that the code exists through the reference tools before stating there is nothing.

## Coded status fields

Tools return statuses in two forms: a _CODE column (the X3 local menu value) and a _LABEL column resolved to text in the format Label (code). Always display the _LABEL column, never the code on its own. _CODE columns are only there to build the filters of a follow-up call.

One exception: ORDER_TYPE on x3_sales_order_lines stays a raw code (SON, WEB). Return it as is, without inventing a meaning for it.

## Business precautions

- STOCK_AVAILABLE is not STOCK_TOTAL. Available removes allocations.
- Billed and ordered are two distinct horizons, never a cumulative figure: billed is realised, ordered is a commitment not yet invoiced. Do not add them up without saying so.
- Credit memos count as negative in billed revenue, proformas as zero.
- Never invent a field, table, code or tool name. If a piece of data is not in the result, say so.
- Write access: never call x3_sales_order_create without explicit confirmation. Recap customer, site, items and quantities, then wait for a clear go-ahead.

## Answer

Concise and structured. Key figures first, detail afterwards, currency and horizon always stated. Flag any data anomaly you notice along the way.

parameters.toolDescription:
Sage X3 customer reference data (BPCUSTOMER table). Returns: CUSTOMER_CODE (BPCNUM_0), CUSTOMER_NAME, CATEGORY (BCGCOD_0), CURRENCY, STATUS_CODE (local menu 1: 2 for active, 1 for inactive), CREDIT_LIMIT (in the customer's currency). Use it to resolve a customer name into a customer code before any call to the sales order tools, or to list the customers of a category. It holds no sales data: for revenue, use x3_revenue_summary.

Do not add quotes or % around values: the filters add them themselves. Multi-value filters are separated by a comma.

Maximum 200 rows. If rowCount is 200 the result is truncated: narrow it down with name_contains or category and tell the user rather than drawing a conclusion.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    BPC.BPCNUM_0 AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPC.BPCNAM_0 AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    BPC.BCGCOD_0 AS CATEGORY,
    BPC.CUR_0    AS CURRENCY,
    BPC.BPCSTA_0 AS STATUS_CODE,
    BPC.OSTAUZ_0 AS CREDIT_LIMIT
FROM BPCUSTOMER BPC
WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND BPC.BPCNUM_0 IN ({{customer_code}})]]
[[AND UPPER(BPC.BPCNAM_0) LIKE UPPER({{name_contains}})]]
[[AND BPC.BCGCOD_0 IN ({{category}})]]
[[AND BPC.BPCSTA_0 IN ({{status}})]]
ORDER BY BPC.BPCNUM_0

parameters.toolDescription:
Item search in the Sage X3 reference data (ITMMASTER). This is the tool to use to resolve a description into a reference (ITMREF_0), or to list the items of a category, a statistical group, a buyer or a planner.

Deliberately short answer, 10 columns: ITEM, DESCRIPTION (resolved through ATEXTRA, falling back to the language of the item record), SEARCH_KEY, CATEGORY_CODE and CATEGORY_LABEL, ITEM_STATUS_CODE and ITEM_STATUS_LABEL, STOCK_UNIT, STOCK_TOTAL_ALL_SITES, STOCK_AVAILABLE_ALL_SITES.

The stock shown is an all-site total, good for an order of magnitude only: for stock by site use x3_stock_available. For the full setup of an item, use x3_item_detail.

Do not add quotes or % around values. Write FIN008 and not 'FIN008', write Adult and not %Adult%. Maximum 500 rows: always pass at least one filter.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    ITM.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.SEAKEY_0        AS SEARCH_KEY,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0)   AS CATEGORY_LABEL,
    ITM.ITMSTA_0        AS ITEM_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_STA.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.ITMSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS ITEM_STATUS_LABEL,
    ITM.STU_0           AS STOCK_UNIT,
    ISNULL(STK.STOCK_TOTAL_A, 0)    AS STOCK_TOTAL_ALL_SITES,
    ISNULL(STK.STOCK_AVAILABLE, 0) AS STOCK_AVAILABLE_ALL_SITES

FROM ITMMASTER ITM

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ITMREF_0,
           SUM(ISNULL(PHYSTO_0, 0)) AS STOCK_TOTAL_A,
           SUM(ISNULL(PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(GLOALL_0, 0)) AS STOCK_AVAILABLE
    FROM   ITMMVT
    GROUP  BY ITMREF_0
) STK ON STK.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0 = 'TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_STA ON ML_STA.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_STA.LANCHP_0=246 AND ML_STA.LANNUM_0=ITM.ITMSTA_0

WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND ITM.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND (UPPER(ITM.ITMDES1_0) LIKE UPPER({{description}}) OR UPPER(ISNULL(DES1.LABEL, '')) LIKE UPPER({{description}}))]]
[[AND UPPER(ITM.SEAKEY_0)  LIKE UPPER({{search_key}})]]
[[AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 IN ({{category}})]]
[[AND ITM.ITMSTA_0 IN ({{item_status}})]]
[[AND ITM.TSICOD_0 IN ({{stat_group1}})]]
[[AND ITM.TSICOD_1 IN ({{stat_group2}})]]
[[AND ITM.SALFLG_0 = {{sold}}]]
[[AND ITM.PURFLG_0 = {{purchased}}]]
[[AND ITM.MFGFLG_0 = {{manufactured}}]]
[[AND ITM.STU_0    IN ({{stock_unit}})]]
[[AND ITM.BUY_0    IN ({{buyer}})]]
[[AND ITM.PLANNER_0 IN ({{planner}})]]
[[AND {{with_stock}} = 1 AND ISNULL(STK.STOCK_TOTAL_A, 0) <> 0]]
ORDER BY ITM.ITMREF_0

parameters.toolDescription:
Mapping between the Sage X3 item reference and the customer's own reference (ITMBPC table). Call it when a customer quotes a reference that does not exist in the item reference data, or to list what is referenced for a customer.

Returns CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_CATEGORY, CUSTOMER_STATUS_LABEL, ITEM, X3_DESCRIPTION, CUSTOMER_REF, CUSTOMER_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVE_LABEL (Yes / No, or empty when the field is not filled in on the folder), ITEM_STATUS_LABEL, ITEM_CATEGORY_LABEL, the units and packing specific to the item x customer pair (CUSTOMER_SALES_UNIT, SAL_STK_COEF, STOCK_UNIT, PACKING, PACKING_CAPACITY, PACK_UNIT_1 and 2, PACK_COEF_1 and 2, CUSTOMER_SHELF_LIFE_COEF), STOCK_AVAILABLE_ALL_SITES, CREATED_ON, UPDATED_ON, UPDATED_BY.

Always quote the _LABEL columns. Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 300 rows.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    ITU.BPCNUM_0  AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPC.BPCNAM_0  AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    BPC.BCGCOD_0  AS CUSTOMER_CATEGORY,

    /* --- Customer status: local menu 1 --- */
    BPC.BPCSTA_0        AS CUSTOMER_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_BPC.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(BPC.BPCSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS CUSTOMER_STATUS_LABEL,

    ITU.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS X3_DESCRIPTION,
    ITU.ITMREFBPC_0     AS CUSTOMER_REF,
    ITU.ITMDESBPC_0     AS CUSTOMER_DESCRIPTION,

    /* --- Cross-reference active: local menu 1 --- */
    ITU.ENAFLG_0        AS ACTIVE_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_ENA.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITU.ENAFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ACTIVE_LABEL,

    /* --- Item status: local menu 246 --- */
    ITM.ITMSTA_0        AS ITEM_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_ITM.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.ITMSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ITEM_STATUS_LABEL,

    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS ITEM_CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0)   AS ITEM_CATEGORY_LABEL,

    /* --- Units and packing specific to the item x customer pair --- */
    ITU.SAU_0         AS CUSTOMER_SALES_UNIT,
    ITU.SAUSTUCOE_0   AS SAL_STK_COEF,
    ITM.STU_0         AS STOCK_UNIT,
    ITU.PCK_0         AS PACKING,
    ITU.PCKCAP_0      AS PACKING_CAPACITY,
    ITU.PCU1_0        AS PACK_UNIT_1,
    ITU.PCUSAUCOE1_0  AS PACK_COEF_1,
    ITU.PCU2_0        AS PACK_UNIT_2,
    ITU.PCUSAUCOE2_0  AS PACK_COEF_2,
    ITU.DLUBPC_0      AS CUSTOMER_SHELF_LIFE_COEF,

    /* --- All-site available stock for the item, handy to answer "can I ship it?" straight away --- */
    ISNULL(STK.STOCK_AVAILABLE, 0) AS STOCK_AVAILABLE_ALL_SITES,

    NULLIF(ITU.CREDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS CREATED_ON,
    NULLIF(ITU.UPDDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS UPDATED_ON,
    ITU.UPDUSR_0        AS UPDATED_BY

FROM ITMBPC ITU

LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC
       ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = ITU.BPCNUM_0

LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM
       ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = ITU.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ITMREF_0,
           SUM(ISNULL(PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(GLOALL_0, 0))
               AS STOCK_AVAILABLE
    FROM   ITMMVT
    GROUP  BY ITMREF_0
) STK ON STK.ITMREF_0 = ITU.ITMREF_0

/* --- Item category label: ATEXTRA / ITMCATEG / TCLAXX / ENG --- */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD,
           MAX(TEXTE_0)                      AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG'
      AND  ZONE_0   = 'TCLAXX'
      AND  LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_ENA
       ON  ML_ENA.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_ENA.LANCHP_0 = 1
       AND ML_ENA.LANNUM_0 = ITU.ENAFLG_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_BPC
       ON  ML_BPC.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_BPC.LANCHP_0 = 1
       AND ML_BPC.LANNUM_0 = BPC.BPCSTA_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_ITM
       ON  ML_ITM.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_ITM.LANCHP_0 = 246
       AND ML_ITM.LANNUM_0 = ITM.ITMSTA_0

WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND ITU.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND ITU.BPCNUM_0 IN ({{customer_code}})]]
[[AND UPPER(BPC.BPCNAM_0) LIKE UPPER({{customer_name}})]]
[[AND ITU.ITMREFBPC_0 IN ({{customer_ref}})]]
[[AND UPPER(ITU.ITMREFBPC_0) LIKE UPPER({{customer_ref_contains}})]]
[[AND UPPER(ITU.ITMDESBPC_0) LIKE UPPER({{customer_description}})]]
[[AND (UPPER(ITM.ITMDES1_0) LIKE UPPER({{description}}) OR UPPER(ISNULL(DES1.LABEL, '')) LIKE UPPER({{description}}))]]
[[AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 IN ({{category}})]]
[[AND ITU.ENAFLG_0 = {{active}}]]
[[AND ITM.ITMSTA_0 IN ({{item_status}})]]

ORDER BY ITU.BPCNUM_0, ITU.ITMREF_0

parameter.value: ={{ $fromAI('item', `One or more Sage X3 item references (ITMREF_0), comma separated, e.g. FIN008 or FIN008,FIN006. No quotes. Leave empty for all items.`, 'string', '') }}

parameters.toolDescription:
Full Sage X3 item record (ITMMASTER): around sixty setup columns for one or a few specific items. Call it only when the question is about the setup of an identified item (stock management, lot, traceability, expiry, units and coefficients, barcode, GTIN, customs code, buyer, planner, replenishment lead time).

To simply find a reference from a description, use x3_item_search, which is far lighter. Never call this tool to browse a set of items.

Always display the _LABEL columns, never the codes on their own. Maximum 50 rows.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    ITM.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS DESCRIPTION,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES2.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES2_0)       AS DESCRIPTION_2,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES3.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES3_0)       AS DESCRIPTION_3,
    ITM.SEAKEY_0        AS SEARCH_KEY,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0)   AS CATEGORY_LABEL,

    /* --- Item status: local menu 246 --- */
    ITM.ITMSTA_0        AS ITEM_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_STA.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.ITMSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ITEM_STATUS_LABEL,

    /* --- Management mode: local menu 297 --- */
    ITM.STDFLG_0        AS MANAGEMENT_MODE_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_STD.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.STDFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS MANAGEMENT_MODE_LABEL,

    /* --- Stock management: local menu 215 --- */
    ITM.STOMGTCOD_0     AS STOCK_MANAGEMENT_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SMG.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.STOMGTCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS STOCK_MANAGEMENT_LABEL,

    /* --- Lot management: local menu 2711 --- */
    ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0     AS LOT_MANAGEMENT_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_LOT.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS LOT_MANAGEMENT_LABEL,

    /* --- Serial number management: local menu 210 --- */
    ITM.SERMGTCOD_0     AS SERIAL_MANAGEMENT_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SER.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.SERMGTCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS SERIAL_MANAGEMENT_LABEL,

    /* --- Traceability: local menu 754 --- */
    ITM.TRKCOD_0        AS TRACEABILITY_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_TRK.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.TRKCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS TRACEABILITY_LABEL,

    /* --- Expiry management: local menu 211 --- */
    ITM.EXYMGTCOD_0     AS EXPIRY_MANAGEMENT_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_EXY.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.EXYMGTCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS EXPIRY_MANAGEMENT_LABEL,
    ITM.SHL_0           AS SHELF_LIFE,

    /* --- Yes / No flags: local menu 1 --- */
    ITM.PURFLG_0        AS PURCHASED_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_PUR.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.PURFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS PURCHASED_LABEL,
    ITM.SALFLG_0        AS SOLD_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SAL.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.SALFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS SOLD_LABEL,
    ITM.MFGFLG_0        AS MANUFACTURED_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_MFG.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.MFGFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS MANUFACTURED_LABEL,
    ITM.DLVFLG_0        AS DELIVERABLE_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_DLV.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.DLVFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS DELIVERABLE_LABEL,
    ITM.NEGSTO_0        AS NEGATIVE_STOCK_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_NEG.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.NEGSTO_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS NEGATIVE_STOCK_LABEL,

    /* --- Statistical groups: miscellaneous tables ATABDIV 20 / 21 / 22 --- */
    ITM.TSICOD_0        AS STAT_GROUP1_CODE,
    ISNULL(AD_TS0.TEXTE_0, 'Not set')  AS STAT_GROUP1_LABEL,
    ITM.TSICOD_1        AS STAT_GROUP2_CODE,
    ISNULL(AD_TS1.TEXTE_0, 'Not set')  AS STAT_GROUP2_LABEL,
    ITM.TSICOD_2        AS STAT_GROUP3_CODE,
    ISNULL(AD_TS2.TEXTE_0, 'Not set')  AS STAT_GROUP3_LABEL,

    /* --- Units and conversions --- */
    ITM.STU_0        AS STOCK_UNIT,
    ITM.SAU_0        AS SALES_UNIT,
    ITM.SAUSTUCOE_0  AS SAL_STK_COEF,
    ITM.PUU_0        AS PURCHASE_UNIT,
    ITM.PUUSTUCOE_0  AS PUR_STK_COEF,
    ITM.WEU_0        AS WEIGHT_UNIT,
    ITM.ITMWEI_0     AS UNIT_WEIGHT,
    ITM.VOU_0        AS VOLUME_UNIT,
    ITM.ITMVOU_0     AS UNIT_VOLUME,

    /* --- External identifiers and logistics --- */
    ITM.EANCOD_0     AS BARCODE,
    ITM.GTIN_0       AS GTIN,
    ITM.CUSREF_0     AS CUSTOMS_CODE,
    ITM.ACCCOD_0     AS ACCOUNTING_CODE,
    ITM.PURBASPRI_0  AS PURCHASE_BASE_PRICE,
    ITM.BUY_0        AS BUYER,
    ITM.PLANNER_0    AS PLANNER,
    ITM.OFS_0        AS REPLENISHMENT_LEAD_TIME,

    /* --- All-site stock total (0 when the item is not stock managed) --- */
    ISNULL(STK.STOCK_TOTAL_A, 0)    AS STOCK_TOTAL_A_ALL_SITES,
    ISNULL(STK.STOCK_AVAILABLE, 0) AS STOCK_AVAILABLE_ALL_SITES,
    ISNULL(STK.SITE_COUNT, 0)         AS SITES_WITH_STOCK,

    NULLIF(ITM.CREDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS CREATED_ON,
    NULLIF(ITM.UPDDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS UPDATED_ON,
    ITM.UPDUSR_0        AS UPDATED_BY

FROM ITMMASTER ITM
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES2AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES2 ON DES2.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES3AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES3 ON DES3.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ITMREF_0,
           SUM(ISNULL(PHYSTO_0, 0)) AS STOCK_TOTAL_A,
           SUM(ISNULL(PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(GLOALL_0, 0))
                                    AS STOCK_AVAILABLE,
           COUNT(*)                 AS SITE_COUNT
    FROM   ITMMVT
    GROUP  BY ITMREF_0
) STK ON STK.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0

/* --- Item category label: ATEXTRA / ITMCATEG / TCLAXX / ENG. Depending on the folder the code
       sits either in IDENT1_0 or in IDENT2_0 (key ITG0 = ""+TCLCOD), hence the concatenation. The
       derived table is tiny, the cost is negligible. --- */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD,
           MAX(TEXTE_0)                      AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG'
      AND  ZONE_0   = 'TCLAXX'
      AND  LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_STA ON ML_STA.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_STA.LANCHP_0=246  AND ML_STA.LANNUM_0=ITM.ITMSTA_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_STD ON ML_STD.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_STD.LANCHP_0=297  AND ML_STD.LANNUM_0=ITM.STDFLG_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SMG ON ML_SMG.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_SMG.LANCHP_0=215  AND ML_SMG.LANNUM_0=ITM.STOMGTCOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_LOT ON ML_LOT.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_LOT.LANCHP_0=2711 AND ML_LOT.LANNUM_0=ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SER ON ML_SER.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_SER.LANCHP_0=210  AND ML_SER.LANNUM_0=ITM.SERMGTCOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_TRK ON ML_TRK.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_TRK.LANCHP_0=754  AND ML_TRK.LANNUM_0=ITM.TRKCOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_EXY ON ML_EXY.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_EXY.LANCHP_0=211  AND ML_EXY.LANNUM_0=ITM.EXYMGTCOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_PUR ON ML_PUR.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_PUR.LANCHP_0=1    AND ML_PUR.LANNUM_0=ITM.PURFLG_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SAL ON ML_SAL.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_SAL.LANCHP_0=1    AND ML_SAL.LANNUM_0=ITM.SALFLG_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_MFG ON ML_MFG.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_MFG.LANCHP_0=1    AND ML_MFG.LANNUM_0=ITM.MFGFLG_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_DLV ON ML_DLV.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_DLV.LANCHP_0=1    AND ML_DLV.LANNUM_0=ITM.DLVFLG_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_NEG ON ML_NEG.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_NEG.LANCHP_0=1    AND ML_NEG.LANNUM_0=ITM.NEGSTO_0

LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_TS0
       ON  AD_TS0.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV' AND AD_TS0.ZONE_0='LNGDES'
       AND AD_TS0.LANGUE_0='ENG'     AND AD_TS0.IDENT1_0='20'
       AND AD_TS0.IDENT2_0=ITM.TSICOD_0
LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_TS1
       ON  AD_TS1.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV' AND AD_TS1.ZONE_0='LNGDES'
       AND AD_TS1.LANGUE_0='ENG'     AND AD_TS1.IDENT1_0='21'
       AND AD_TS1.IDENT2_0=ITM.TSICOD_1
LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_TS2
       ON  AD_TS2.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV' AND AD_TS2.ZONE_0='LNGDES'
       AND AD_TS2.LANGUE_0='ENG'     AND AD_TS2.IDENT1_0='22'
       AND AD_TS2.IDENT2_0=ITM.TSICOD_2

WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND ITM.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND (UPPER(ITM.ITMDES1_0) LIKE UPPER({{description}}) OR UPPER(ISNULL(DES1.LABEL, '')) LIKE UPPER({{description}}))]]
ORDER BY ITM.ITMREF_0

parameters.toolDescription:
Available stock by item and by site, from the ITMMVT totals. This is the tool to call for the question how much is left of a given item. One row per item x site pair.

Returns SITE, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, STOCK_UNIT, CATEGORY_LABEL, ITEM_STATUS_LABEL, STOCK_MANAGEMENT_LABEL, STOCK_ACCEPTED_A, STOCK_QUALITY_Q, STOCK_REJECTED_R, STOCK_TOTAL, ALLOCATED_DETAILED, ALLOCATED_GLOBAL, SHORTAGE_GLOBAL, EXPECTED_SALES_ORDERS, EXPECTED_REPLENISHMENT, IN_TRANSIT, PENDING_ISSUES, STOCK_AVAILABLE, REORDER_POINT, SAFETY_STOCK, STOCK_MAX, BELOW_REORDER_POINT (Yes / No), AVERAGE_COST, STOCK_VALUE_A, LAST_RECEIPT, LAST_ISSUE, LAST_COUNT.

The figure to quote to the user is STOCK_AVAILABLE, equal to accepted physical stock minus detailed allocations minus global allocations. Do not quote STOCK_TOTAL as available stock.

For the detail by lot and location, use x3_stock_detail. Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 400 rows.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    ITV.STOFCY_0        AS SITE,
    ITV.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.STU_0           AS STOCK_UNIT,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0)   AS CATEGORY_LABEL,

    /* --- Item status: local menu 246 --- */
    ITM.ITMSTA_0        AS ITEM_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_STA.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.ITMSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ITEM_STATUS_LABEL,

    /* --- Stock management: local menu 215 --- */
    ITM.STOMGTCOD_0     AS STOCK_MANAGEMENT_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SMG.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(ITM.STOMGTCOD_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS STOCK_MANAGEMENT_LABEL,

    /* --- Quantities by stock status --- */
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_ACCEPTED_A,
    ISNULL(ITV.CTLSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_QUALITY_Q,
    ISNULL(ITV.REJSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_REJECTED_R,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) + ISNULL(ITV.CTLSTO_0, 0) + ISNULL(ITV.REJSTO_0, 0)
                                AS STOCK_TOTAL,

    /* --- Commitments --- */
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0)  AS ALLOCATED_DETAILED,
    ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0)  AS ALLOCATED_GLOBAL,
    ISNULL(ITV.GLOSHT_0, 0)  AS SHORTAGE_GLOBAL,
    ISNULL(ITV.SALSTO_0, 0)  AS EXPECTED_SALES_ORDERS,
    ISNULL(ITV.ORDSTO_0, 0)  AS EXPECTED_REPLENISHMENT,
    ISNULL(ITV.TRFSTO_0, 0)  AS IN_TRANSIT,
    ISNULL(ITV.WAISTO_0, 0)  AS PENDING_ISSUES,

    /* --- The figure to quote to the user --- */
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0)
                                AS STOCK_AVAILABLE,

    /* --- Replenishment parameters (item x site) --- */
    ISNULL(ITF.REOTSD_0, 0)  AS REORDER_POINT,
    ISNULL(ITF.SAFSTO_0, 0)  AS SAFETY_STOCK,
    ISNULL(ITF.MAXSTO_0, 0)  AS STOCK_MAX,
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(ITF.REOTSD_0, 0) > 0
         AND (ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0)
              - ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0)) < ITF.REOTSD_0
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END                         AS BELOW_REORDER_POINT,

    ITV.AVC_0                   AS AVERAGE_COST,
    ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) * ISNULL(ITV.AVC_0, 0)
                                AS STOCK_VALUE_A,
    NULLIF(ITV.LASRCPDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LAST_RECEIPT,
    NULLIF(ITV.LASISSDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LAST_ISSUE,
    NULLIF(ITV.LASCUNDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LAST_COUNT

FROM ITMMVT ITV

LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM
       ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = ITV.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)

LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF
       ON  ITF.ITMREF_0 = ITV.ITMREF_0
       AND ITF.STOFCY_0 = ITV.STOFCY_0

/* --- Item category label: ATEXTRA / ITMCATEG / TCLAXX / ENG --- */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD,
           MAX(TEXTE_0)                      AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMCATEG'
      AND  ZONE_0   = 'TCLAXX'
      AND  LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_STA
       ON  ML_STA.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_STA.LANCHP_0 = 246
       AND ML_STA.LANNUM_0 = ITM.ITMSTA_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SMG
       ON  ML_SMG.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_SMG.LANCHP_0 = 215
       AND ML_SMG.LANNUM_0 = ITM.STOMGTCOD_0

WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND ITV.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND (UPPER(ITM.ITMDES1_0) LIKE UPPER({{description}}) OR UPPER(ISNULL(DES1.LABEL, '')) LIKE UPPER({{description}}))]]
[[AND ITV.STOFCY_0 IN ({{site}})]]
[[AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 IN ({{category}})]]
[[AND ITM.ITMSTA_0 IN ({{item_status}})]]
[[AND {{only_in_stock}} = 1 AND ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) <> 0]]
[[AND {{below_reorder_point}} = 1
      AND ISNULL(ITF.REOTSD_0, 0) > 0
      AND (ISNULL(ITV.PHYSTO_0, 0) - ISNULL(ITV.PHYALL_0, 0)
           - ISNULL(ITV.GLOALL_0, 0)) < ITF.REOTSD_0]]

ORDER BY ITV.ITMREF_0, ITV.STOFCY_0

parameters.toolDescription:
Stock detail by lot, sublot, location and status (STOCK table). Use it for where the stock is, which lots, what is under quality control.

Returns SITE, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, LOT, SUBLOT, SUPPLIER_LOT, SERIAL_NUMBER, LOCATION, LOCATION_TYPE, WAREHOUSE, CONTAINER, OWNER, STOCK_STATUS_LABEL (Accepted A / Quality control Q / Rejected R), STOCK_QTY, STOCK_UNIT, ACTIVE_QTY, ALLOCATED_QTY, WIP_QTY, AVAILABLE_QTY, LAST_RECEIPT, LAST_ISSUE, LAST_COUNT, COUNT_IN_PROGRESS_LABEL.

For a simple total by site, prefer x3_stock_available, which is far faster. Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 400 rows.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    STO.STOFCY_0        AS SITE,
    STO.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS DESCRIPTION,
    STO.LOT_0           AS LOT,
    STO.SLO_0           AS SUBLOT,
    STO.BPSLOT_0        AS SUPPLIER_LOT,
    STO.SERNUM_0        AS SERIAL_NUMBER,
    STO.LOC_0           AS LOCATION,
    STO.LOCTYP_0        AS LOCATION_TYPE,
    STO.WRH_0           AS WAREHOUSE,
    STO.PALNUM_0        AS CONTAINER,
    STO.OWNER_0         AS OWNER,

    /* --- Stock status: A / Q / R code, not a local menu --- */
    STO.STA_0           AS STOCK_STATUS_CODE,
    CASE STO.STA_0
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Accepted (A)'
        WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Quality control (Q)'
        WHEN 'R' THEN 'Rejected (R)'
        ELSE ISNULL(NULLIF(STO.STA_0, ''), 'Not specified')
    END                 AS STOCK_STATUS_LABEL,

    STO.QTYSTU_0     AS STOCK_QTY,
    ITM.STU_0        AS STOCK_UNIT,

parameters.toolDescription:
Detailed stock movements (STOJOU journal): receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments. Returns SITE, DOCUMENT_NUMBER, LINE_NUMBER, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, MOVEMENT_DATE, ACCOUNTING_DATE, MOVEMENT_TYPE_CODE and MOVEMENT_TYPE_LABEL, DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE and DOCUMENT_TYPE_LABEL, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_LABEL, SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER, MOVEMENT_FAMILY_LABEL, DIRECTION (Inbound / Outbound / Neutral), signed STOCK_QTY, STOCK_UNIT, LOT, SUBLOT, LOCATION, WAREHOUSE, SERIAL_NUMBER, STOCK_STATUS_LABEL (Accepted A / Quality control Q / Rejected R), VALUATION_PRICE, MOVEMENT_VALUE, COST_ORIGIN_LABEL, ADJUSTED_LABEL, BP_CODE, BP_NAME, USER_CODE, MOVEMENT_DESCRIPTION.

Always quote the _LABEL columns, never the raw codes. Quantities are signed: positive on receipts, negative on issues.

As soon as the question is about a volume rather than the detail (how much went out in June), use x3_stock_movements_summary, which aggregates on the database side.

Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 400 rows, sorted by descending date: always bound date_from and date_to.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    STJ.STOFCY_0        AS SITE,
    STJ.VCRNUM_0        AS DOCUMENT_NUMBER,
    STJ.VCRLIN_0        AS LINE_NUMBER,
    STJ.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS DESCRIPTION,

    NULLIF(STJ.IPTDAT_0, '1753-01-01')  AS MOVEMENT_DATE,
    NULLIF(STJ.ACCDAT_0, '1753-01-01')  AS ACCOUNTING_DATE,
    NULLIF(STJ.CREDAT_0, '1753-01-01')  AS CREATED_ON,

    /* --- Movement type: local menu 704 --- */
    STJ.TRSTYP_0        AS MOVEMENT_TYPE_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_TRS.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(STJ.TRSTYP_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS MOVEMENT_TYPE_LABEL,

    /* --- Document type: local menu 701 --- */
    STJ.VCRTYP_0        AS DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_VCR.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(STJ.VCRTYP_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS DOCUMENT_TYPE_LABEL,

    /* --- Source document: local menu 701 --- */
    STJ.VCRTYPORI_0     AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_ORI.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(STJ.VCRTYPORI_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_LABEL,
    ISNULL(STJ.VCRNUMORI_0, '')         AS SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER,

    /* --- Transaction family: miscellaneous table ATABDIV 9 --- */
    STJ.TRSFAM_0        AS MOVEMENT_FAMILY_CODE,
    ISNULL(AD_FAM.TEXTE_0, 'Not specified')
                        AS MOVEMENT_FAMILY_LABEL,

    /* --- Movement direction, derived from the sign of the quantity --- */
    CASE
        WHEN STJ.QTYSTU_0 > 0 THEN 'Inbound'
        WHEN STJ.QTYSTU_0 < 0 THEN 'Outbound'
        ELSE 'Neutral'
    END                 AS DIRECTION,

    STJ.QTYSTU_0  AS STOCK_QTY,
    STJ.STU_0     AS STOCK_UNIT,
    STJ.QTYPCU_0  AS PACKING_QTY,
    STJ.PCU_0     AS PACKING_UNIT,
    STJ.ACTQTY_0  AS ACTIVE_QTY,
    STJ.POT_0     AS POTENCY,

    STJ.LOT_0     AS LOT,
    STJ.SLO_0     AS SUBLOT,
    STJ.LOC_0     AS LOCATION,
    STJ.WRH_0     AS WAREHOUSE,
    STJ.SERNUM_0  AS SERIAL_NUMBER,

    /* --- Stock status: A / Q / R code, not a local menu --- */
    STJ.STA_0           AS STOCK_STATUS_CODE,
    CASE STJ.STA_0
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Accepted (A)'
        WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Quality control (Q)'
        WHEN 'R' THEN 'Rejected (R)'
        ELSE ISNULL(NULLIF(STJ.STA_0, ''), 'Not specified')
    END                 AS STOCK_STATUS_LABEL,

    STJ.PRIVAL_0  AS VALUATION_PRICE,
    STJ.AMTVAL_0  AS MOVEMENT_VALUE,

    /* --- Cost origin: local menu 705 --- */
    STJ.PRINAT_0        AS COST_ORIGIN_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_PRI.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(STJ.PRINAT_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS COST_ORIGIN_LABEL,

    /* --- Adjusted movement: local menu 1 --- */
    STJ.REGFLG_0        AS ADJUSTED_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_REG.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(STJ.REGFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ADJUSTED_LABEL,

    STJ.BPRNUM_0  AS BP_CODE,
    BPR.BPRNAM_0  AS BP_NAME,
    STJ.CREUSR_0  AS USER_CODE,
    STJ.MVTDES_0  AS MOVEMENT_DESCRIPTION

FROM STOJOU STJ

LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM
       ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = STJ.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)

LEFT JOIN BPARTNER BPR
       ON BPR.BPRNUM_0 = STJ.BPRNUM_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_TRS
       ON  ML_TRS.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_TRS.LANCHP_0 = 704
       AND ML_TRS.LANNUM_0 = STJ.TRSTYP_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_VCR
       ON  ML_VCR.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_VCR.LANCHP_0 = 701
       AND ML_VCR.LANNUM_0 = STJ.VCRTYP_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_ORI
       ON  ML_ORI.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_ORI.LANCHP_0 = 701
       AND ML_ORI.LANNUM_0 = STJ.VCRTYPORI_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_PRI
       ON  ML_PRI.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_PRI.LANCHP_0 = 705
       AND ML_PRI.LANNUM_0 = STJ.PRINAT_0

LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_REG
       ON  ML_REG.LAN_0    = 'ENG'
       AND ML_REG.LANCHP_0 = 1
       AND ML_REG.LANNUM_0 = STJ.REGFLG_0

LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_FAM
       ON  AD_FAM.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV'
       AND AD_FAM.ZONE_0   = 'LNGDES'
       AND AD_FAM.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
       AND AD_FAM.IDENT1_0 = '9'
       AND AD_FAM.IDENT2_0 = STJ.TRSFAM_0

WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND STJ.ITMREF_0    IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND (UPPER(ITM.ITMDES1_0) LIKE UPPER({{description}}) OR UPPER(ISNULL(DES1.LABEL, '')) LIKE UPPER({{description}}))]]
[[AND STJ.STOFCY_0    IN ({{site}})]]
[[AND STJ.LOC_0       IN ({{location}})]]
[[AND STJ.LOT_0       IN ({{lot}})]]
[[AND STJ.VCRNUM_0    IN ({{document_number}})]]
[[AND STJ.TRSTYP_0    IN ({{movement_type}})]]
[[AND STJ.VCRTYP_0    IN ({{document_type}})]]
[[AND STJ.TRSFAM_0    IN ({{movement_family}})]]
[[AND STJ.BPRNUM_0    IN ({{business_partner}})]]
[[AND STJ.CREUSR_0    IN ({{user_code}})]]
[[AND STJ.STA_0       IN ({{stock_status}})]]
[[AND SIGN(STJ.QTYSTU_0) = {{direction}}]]
[[AND STJ.IPTDAT_0   >= {{date_from}}]]
[[AND STJ.IPTDAT_0   <= {{date_to}}]]

ORDER BY STJ.IPTDAT_0 DESC, STJ.VCRNUM_0, STJ.VCRLIN_0

parameters.toolDescription:
Line-by-line detail of Sage X3 sales orders (SORDER + SORDERP + SORDERQ). One result row per order line: ORDER_NUMBER, ORDER_TYPE, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, SALES_SITE, ORDER_DATE, CURRENCY, STATUS_CODE and STATUS_LABEL (order status, local menu 415), LINE_NUMBER, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, CUSTOMER_REF, ORDERED_QTY, NET_PRICE, LINE_AMOUNT_EXCL_TAX.

Use it for a detail question: which items, which quantities, which orders. This tool gives ORDERED quantities, it is the history. For what is left to deliver and for the order book, use x3_revenue_ordered. For a total or a ranking, use x3_revenue_summary.

ORDER_TYPE stays a raw untranslated code (SON, WEB): return it as is.

Do not add quotes or % around values. Multi-value filters are separated by a comma. Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD.

Maximum 2000 rows, sorted by descending date: always bound date_from and date_to. If rowCount is 2000 the result is truncated, say so and narrow the period.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT 
    SOH.SOHNUM_0  AS ORDER_NUMBER,
    SOH.SOHTYP_0  AS ORDER_TYPE,
    SOH.BPCORD_0  AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPC.BPCNAM_0  AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SOH.SALFCY_0  AS SALES_SITE,
    NULLIF(SOH.ORDDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS ORDER_DATE,
    SOH.CUR_0     AS CURRENCY,
    SOH.ORDSTA_0  AS STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_ORD.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOH.ORDSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' AS STATUS_LABEL,
    SOP.SOPLIN_0   AS LINE_NUMBER,
    SOP.ITMREF_0   AS ITEM,
    SOP.ITMDES1_0  AS DESCRIPTION,
    SOP.ITMREFBPC_0 AS CUSTOMER_REF,
    SOQ.QTY       AS ORDERED_QTY,
    SOP.NETPRI_0  AS NET_PRICE,
    SOQ.QTY * SOP.NETPRI_0 AS LINE_AMOUNT_EXCL_TAX
FROM SORDER SOH
JOIN SORDERP SOP
    ON SOP.SOHNUM_0 = SOH.SOHNUM_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT SOHNUM_0, SOPLIN_0, SUM(QTY_0) AS QTY
    FROM SORDERQ
    GROUP BY SOHNUM_0, SOPLIN_0
) SOQ
    ON  SOQ.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0
    AND SOQ.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0
LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC
    ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOH.BPCORD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_ORD
    ON ML_ORD.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_ORD.LANCHP_0=415 AND ML_ORD.LANNUM_0=SOH.ORDSTA_0
WHERE 1 = 1

[[AND SOH.SOHNUM_0 IN ({{order_number}})]]
[[AND SOP.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND SOH.ORDDAT_0 >= {{date_from}}]]
[[AND SOH.ORDDAT_0 <= {{date_to}}]]
[[AND SOH.SALFCY_0 IN ({{sales_site}})]]
[[AND SOH.SOHTYP_0 IN ({{order_type}})]]

parameters.toolDescription:
THE revenue entry point. Totals aggregated on the database side, converted into euros, over both horizons: billed and ordered.

The level parameter picks the granularity: Total, Month (trend), Customer (customer ranking), Item (item ranking), CustomerItem (what a customer buys, item by item). Always fill it in, otherwise the five granularities come back mixed together in the same answer.

Returns LEVEL, REVENUE_TYPE, YEAR, MONTH, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, DOCUMENT_COUNT, LINE_COUNT, LINES_WITHOUT_RATE, QUANTITY, REVENUE_EUR.

LINES_WITHOUT_RATE counts the lines whose exchange rate to the euro could not be found: their amount is excluded from REVENUE_EUR. If that column is not zero the total is INCOMPLETE: tell the user, give the number of lines involved, and offer to run the query currency by currency rather than presenting REVENUE_EUR as a reliable total. Columns outside the requested level are NULL, that is expected.

Call it before any detail tool as soon as a total, a ranking, a trend or a period comparison is involved. For the line-by-line detail, switch afterwards to x3_revenue_billed or x3_revenue_ordered.

Billed and ordered are two distinct horizons, never a cumulative figure: billed is realised, ordered is a commitment not yet invoiced.

Do not add quotes or % around values. Always bound date_from and date_to.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    AGG.LEVEL               AS LEVEL,
    AGG.REVENUE_TYPE        AS REVENUE_TYPE,
    AGG.YEAR                AS YEAR,
    AGG.MONTH               AS MONTH,
    AGG.CUSTOMER_CODE       AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    AGG.CUSTOMER_NAME       AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    AGG.ITEM                AS ITEM,
    AGG.DESCRIPTION         AS DESCRIPTION,
    AGG.DOCUMENT_COUNT      AS DOCUMENT_COUNT,
    AGG.LINE_COUNT          AS LINE_COUNT,
    AGG.LINES_WITHOUT_RATE  AS LINES_WITHOUT_RATE,
    AGG.QUANTITY            AS QUANTITY,
    AGG.REVENUE_EUR         AS REVENUE_EUR
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.YEAR) = 0                                     THEN 'Month'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0  THEN 'CustomerItem'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0                            THEN 'Customer'
            WHEN GROUPING(CA.ITEM) = 0                                     THEN 'Item'
            ELSE 'Total'
        END                                                         AS LEVEL,
        CA.REVENUE_TYPE,
        CA.YEAR,
        CA.MONTH,
        CA.CUSTOMER_CODE,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(CA.CUSTOMER_CODE) = 0 THEN MAX(CA.CUSTOMER_NAME)  END AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        CA.ITEM,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(CA.ITEM)     = 0 THEN MAX(CA.DESCRIPTION) END AS DESCRIPTION,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CA.DOCUMENT)                             AS DOCUMENT_COUNT,
        COUNT(*)                                                AS LINE_COUNT,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CA.AMOUNT_EUR IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS LINES_WITHOUT_RATE,
        SUM(CA.QUANTITY)                                        AS QUANTITY,
        SUM(CA.AMOUNT_EUR)                                      AS REVENUE_EUR
    FROM (

    /* ---------- Billed ---------- */
    SELECT
        'Billed' AS REVENUE_TYPE,
        SID.NUM_0     AS DOCUMENT,
        SID.SIDLIN_0  AS LINE,
        NULLIF(SIE.ACCDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS REF_DATE,
        YEAR(SIE.ACCDAT_0)                 AS YEAR,
        MONTH(SIE.ACCDAT_0)                AS MONTH,
        SID.BPCINV_0                       AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
        BPR.BPRNAM_0                       AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
        SID.REP1_0                         AS SALES_REP,
        SID.ITMREF_0                       AS ITEM,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)                      AS DESCRIPTION,
        ITM.TCLCOD_0                       AS X3_CATEGORY,
        ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0)  AS X3_CATEGORY_LABEL,
        SID.SALFCY_0                       AS SITE,
        (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.QTY_0          AS QUANTITY,
        SID.STU_0                          AS UNIT,
        SIE.CUR_0                          AS CURRENCY,
        (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0     AS AMOUNT_CURRENCY,
        (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0
        * CASE WHEN SIE.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END      AS AMOUNT_EUR,
        CAST(SIE.SIVTYP_0 AS VARCHAR(30))  AS STATUS_CODE,
        CAST(CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 0)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Invoice (1)'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Credit memo (2)'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Debit note (3)'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Credit note (4)'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Proforma (5)'
        ELSE 'Not specified (' + RTRIM(ISNULL(SIE.SIVTYP_0, '')) + ')'
    END AS VARCHAR(60))           AS STATUS_LABEL
    FROM SINVOICED SID
    JOIN SINVOICE  SIE ON SIE.NUM_0 = SID.NUM_0
LEFT JOIN TABSIVTYP TIV ON TIV.SIVTYP_0 = SIE.SIVTYP_0
    LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SID.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
        FROM   ATEXTRA
        WHERE  CODFIC_0='ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0='TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0='ENG'
        GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
    ) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)
    LEFT JOIN BPARTNER  BPR ON BPR.BPRNUM_0 = SID.BPCINV_0
    WHERE 1 = 1
    [[AND SIE.ACCDAT_0 >= {{date_from}}]]
    [[AND SIE.ACCDAT_0 <= {{date_to}}]]

    UNION ALL

    /* ---------- Ordered ---------- */
    SELECT
        'Ordered',
        SOQ.SOHNUM_0,
        SOQ.SOPLIN_0,
        NULLIF(SOQ.SHIDAT_0, '1753-01-01'),
        YEAR(SOQ.SHIDAT_0),
        MONTH(SOQ.SHIDAT_0),
        SOQ.BPCORD_0,
        BPC.BPCNAM_0,
        SOP.REP1_0,
        SOQ.ITMREF_0,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0),
        ITM.TCLCOD_0,
        ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0),
        SOQ.STOFCY_0,
        (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)),
        SOP.STU_0,
        SOH.CUR_0,
        (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0,
        (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0
        * CASE WHEN SOH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END,
        CAST(CAST(SOQ.SOQSTA_0 AS INT) AS VARCHAR(30)),
        CAST(ISNULL(ML_SOQ.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
             + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.SOQSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
             AS VARCHAR(60))
    FROM SORDERQ SOQ
    JOIN SORDERP SOP ON SOP.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0 AND SOP.SOPLIN_0 = SOQ.SOPLIN_0
    LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH     ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOQ.BPCORD_0
    LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER  ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOQ.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
        FROM   ATEXTRA
        WHERE  CODFIC_0='ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0='TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0='ENG'
        GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
    ) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)
    LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SOQ  ON ML_SOQ.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_SOQ.LANCHP_0=279
                            AND ML_SOQ.LANNUM_0=SOQ.SOQSTA_0
    WHERE SOQ.SOQSTA_0 < 3                 -- lignes non soldees
    [[AND SOQ.SHIDAT_0 >= {{date_from}}]]
    [[AND SOQ.SHIDAT_0 <= {{date_to}}]]

    ) CA
    WHERE 1 = 1
    [[AND CA.REVENUE_TYPE      IN ({{revenue_type}})]]
    [[AND CA.CUSTOMER_CODE  IN ({{customer_code}})]]
    [[AND UPPER(CA.CUSTOMER_NAME) LIKE UPPER({{customer_name}})]]
    [[AND CA.ITEM      IN ({{item}})]]
    [[AND CA.X3_CATEGORY IN ({{category}})]]
    [[AND CA.SITE         IN ({{site}})]]
    [[AND CA.CURRENCY       IN ({{currency}})]]
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.YEAR, CA.MONTH),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.CUSTOMER_CODE),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.ITEM),
        (CA.REVENUE_TYPE, CA.CUSTOMER_CODE, CA.ITEM)
    )
) AGG
WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND AGG.LEVEL IN ({{level}})]]
ORDER BY AGG.LEVEL, AGG.REVENUE_TYPE, AGG.YEAR, AGG.MONTH, AGG.REVENUE_EUR DESC

parameters.toolDescription:
BILLED revenue, line by line (SINVOICED + SINVOICE). This is actual revenue, to be kept apart from ordered revenue and from forecasts.

Returns REVENUE_TYPE, DOCUMENT, LINE, REF_DATE (accounting date), YEAR, MONTH, CUSTOMER_CODE, CUSTOMER_NAME, SALES_REP, ITEM, DESCRIPTION, X3_CATEGORY and X3_CATEGORY_LABEL, STAT_GROUP1, SITE, SHIPMENT_SITE, QUANTITY, UNIT, CURRENCY, AMOUNT_CURRENCY, EUR_RATE, AMOUNT_EUR, STATUS_CODE (the folder's document type code, e.g. REG, DIR, FCF) and STATUS_LABEL, resolved through TABSIVTYP.INVTYP_0: Invoice (1), Credit memo (2), Debit note (3), Credit note (4), Proforma (5).

The business sign follows INVTYP_0: credit memos and credit notes negative, proformas at zero, invoices and debit notes positive. Use AMOUNT_EUR for any multi-currency total, AMOUNT_CURRENCY only when the question covers a single currency. A EUR_RATE of 0 flags an exchange rate that could not be found for that currency at that date: the value is NULL in the database and rendered as 0 by the transport layer. The line exists but cannot be converted into euros: say so rather than counting it as zero, and reason on AMOUNT_CURRENCY.

Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 1000 rows, sorted by descending accounting date: always bound date_from and date_to.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    'Billed'      AS REVENUE_TYPE,
    SID.NUM_0     AS DOCUMENT,
    SID.SIDLIN_0  AS LINE,
    NULLIF(SIE.ACCDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS REF_DATE,
    YEAR(SIE.ACCDAT_0)  AS YEAR,
    MONTH(SIE.ACCDAT_0) AS MONTH,

    SID.BPCINV_0  AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPR.BPRNAM_0  AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SID.REP1_0    AS SALES_REP,

    SID.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS X3_CATEGORY,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0) AS X3_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    ISNULL(AD_TS0.TEXTE_0, 'Not set') AS STAT_GROUP1,

    SID.SALFCY_0  AS SITE,
    SID.STOFCY_0  AS SHIPMENT_SITE,

    /* --- Business sign applied to the document type --- */
    (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.QTY_0                 AS QUANTITY,
    SID.STU_0           AS UNIT,

    SIE.CUR_0           AS CURRENCY,
    (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0                 AS AMOUNT_CURRENCY,

    /* --- EUR exchange rate --- */
    CASE WHEN SIE.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS EUR_RATE,

    (CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 1) WHEN 2 THEN -1 WHEN 4 THEN -1 WHEN 5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * SID.AMTNOTLIN_0
    * CASE WHEN SIE.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SIE.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SIE.ACCDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS AMOUNT_EUR,

    /* --- Document type: alpha code, not a local menu --- */
    SIE.SIVTYP_0        AS STATUS_CODE,
    CASE ISNULL(TIV.INVTYP_0, 0)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Invoice (1)'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Credit memo (2)'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Debit note (3)'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Credit note (4)'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Proforma (5)'
        ELSE 'Not specified (' + RTRIM(ISNULL(SIE.SIVTYP_0, '')) + ')'
    END                 AS STATUS_LABEL

FROM SINVOICED SID
JOIN SINVOICE  SIE ON SIE.NUM_0    = SID.NUM_0
LEFT JOIN TABSIVTYP TIV ON TIV.SIVTYP_0 = SIE.SIVTYP_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SID.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0='ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0='TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0='ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)
LEFT JOIN BPARTNER  BPR ON BPR.BPRNUM_0 = SID.BPCINV_0
LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_TS0
       ON  AD_TS0.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV' AND AD_TS0.ZONE_0='LNGDES'
       AND AD_TS0.LANGUE_0='ENG'     AND AD_TS0.IDENT1_0='20'
       AND AD_TS0.IDENT2_0=ITM.TSICOD_0
WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND SID.BPCINV_0 IN ({{customer_code}})]]
[[AND UPPER(BPR.BPRNAM_0) LIKE UPPER({{customer_name}})]]
[[AND SID.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 IN ({{category}})]]
[[AND SID.REP1_0   IN ({{sales_rep}})]]
[[AND SID.SALFCY_0 IN ({{site}})]]
[[AND SIE.CUR_0    IN ({{currency}})]]
[[AND TIV.INVTYP_0 IN ({{invoice_type}})]]
[[AND SIE.ACCDAT_0 >= {{date_from}}]]
[[AND SIE.ACCDAT_0 <= {{date_to}}]]
ORDER BY SIE.ACCDAT_0 DESC, SID.NUM_0, SID.SIDLIN_0

parameters.toolDescription:
ORDERED revenue not yet invoiced, in other words the order book. The quantity used is the ordered quantity minus the quantity already invoiced.

Returns the same columns as x3_revenue_billed, with REF_DATE equal to the planned shipment date, plus STATUS_LABEL (line status), ORDER_STATUS_LABEL, ORDER_CATEGORY_LABEL, INVOICED_LABEL, ORDERED_QTY, DELIVERED_QTY, INVOICED_QTY, ALLOCATED_QTY, SHORTAGE_QTY, NET_PRICE.

Never add this revenue to billed revenue: they are two different horizons, not a cumulative figure. For a total or a ranking, go through x3_revenue_summary. Use AMOUNT_EUR for any multi-currency total.

Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 1000 rows: always bound date_from and date_to.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT
    'Ordered'     AS REVENUE_TYPE,
    SOQ.SOHNUM_0  AS DOCUMENT,
    SOQ.SOPLIN_0  AS LINE,
    NULLIF(SOQ.SHIDAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS REF_DATE,
    YEAR(SOQ.SHIDAT_0)  AS YEAR,
    MONTH(SOQ.SHIDAT_0) AS MONTH,

    SOQ.BPCORD_0  AS CUSTOMER_CODE,
    BPC.BPCNAM_0  AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SOP.REP1_0    AS SALES_REP,

    SOQ.ITMREF_0        AS ITEM,
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DES1.LABEL, ''), ITM.ITMDES1_0)       AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITM.TCLCOD_0        AS X3_CATEGORY,
    ISNULL(CAT.LABEL, ITM.TCLCOD_0) AS X3_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    ISNULL(AD_TS0.TEXTE_0, 'Not set') AS STAT_GROUP1,

    SOQ.STOFCY_0        AS SITE,

    (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) AS QUANTITY,
    SOP.STU_0           AS UNIT,

    SOH.CUR_0           AS CURRENCY,
    (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0 AS AMOUNT_CURRENCY,

    CASE WHEN SOH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS EUR_RATE,

    (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) * SOP.NETPRI_0
    * CASE WHEN SOH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP (1) TCH.CHGRAT_0
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC),
        (SELECT TOP (1) 1.0 / NULLIF(TCH.CHGRAT_0, 0)
           FROM TABCHANGE TCH
          WHERE TCH.CUR_0 = 'EUR' AND TCH.CURDEN_0 = SOH.CUR_0 AND TCH.CHGTYP_0 = 1
            AND TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 <= SOH.ORDDAT_0
          ORDER BY TCH.CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC)
    ) END           AS AMOUNT_EUR,

    /* --- Line status: local menu 279 --- */
    SOQ.SOQSTA_0        AS STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_SOQ.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.SOQSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS STATUS_LABEL,

    /* --- Order context, useful to the agent --- */
    SOH.ORDSTA_0        AS ORDER_STATUS_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_ORD.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOH.ORDSTA_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ORDER_STATUS_LABEL,
    SOQ.SOHCAT_0        AS ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_CAT.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.SOHCAT_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS ORDER_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    SOQ.INVFLG_0        AS INVOICED_CODE,
    ISNULL(ML_INV.LANMES_0, 'Unknown')
        + ' (' + CAST(ISNULL(SOQ.INVFLG_0, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                        AS INVOICED_LABEL,
    SOQ.QTY_0     AS ORDERED_QTY,
    SOQ.DLVQTY_0  AS DELIVERED_QTY,
    SOQ.INVQTY_0  AS INVOICED_QTY,
    SOQ.ALLQTY_0  AS ALLOCATED_QTY,
    SOQ.SHTQTY_0  AS SHORTAGE_QTY,
    SOP.NETPRI_0  AS NET_PRICE

FROM SORDERQ SOQ
JOIN SORDERP SOP
     ON  SOP.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0
     AND SOP.SOPLIN_0 = SOQ.SOPLIN_0
LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH     ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0
LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC ON BPC.BPCNUM_0 = SOQ.BPCORD_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER  ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOQ.ITMREF_0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) AS ITMREF, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0 = 'ITMMASTER' AND ZONE_0 = 'DES1AXX' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0)
) DES1 ON DES1.ITMREF = RTRIM(ITM.ITMREF_0)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0) AS TCLCOD, MAX(TEXTE_0) AS LABEL
    FROM   ATEXTRA
    WHERE  CODFIC_0='ITMCATEG' AND ZONE_0='TCLAXX' AND LANGUE_0='ENG'
    GROUP  BY RTRIM(IDENT1_0) + RTRIM(IDENT2_0)
) CAT ON CAT.TCLCOD = RTRIM(ITM.TCLCOD_0)
LEFT JOIN ATEXTRA AD_TS0
       ON  AD_TS0.CODFIC_0='ATABDIV' AND AD_TS0.ZONE_0='LNGDES'
       AND AD_TS0.LANGUE_0='ENG'     AND AD_TS0.IDENT1_0='20'
       AND AD_TS0.IDENT2_0=ITM.TSICOD_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SOQ ON ML_SOQ.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_SOQ.LANCHP_0=279 AND ML_SOQ.LANNUM_0=SOQ.SOQSTA_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_ORD ON ML_ORD.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_ORD.LANCHP_0=415 AND ML_ORD.LANNUM_0=SOH.ORDSTA_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_CAT ON ML_CAT.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_CAT.LANCHP_0=412 AND ML_CAT.LANNUM_0=SOQ.SOHCAT_0
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_INV ON ML_INV.LAN_0='ENG' AND ML_INV.LANCHP_0=1   AND ML_INV.LANNUM_0=SOQ.INVFLG_0
WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND SOQ.BPCORD_0 IN ({{customer_code}})]]
[[AND UPPER(BPC.BPCNAM_0) LIKE UPPER({{customer_name}})]]
[[AND SOQ.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND ITM.TCLCOD_0 IN ({{category}})]]
[[AND SOP.REP1_0   IN ({{sales_rep}})]]
[[AND SOQ.STOFCY_0 IN ({{site}})]]
[[AND SOH.CUR_0    IN ({{currency}})]]
[[AND SOQ.SOHNUM_0 IN ({{order_number}})]]
[[AND SOQ.SOQSTA_0 IN ({{line_status}})]]
[[AND SOH.ORDSTA_0 IN ({{order_status}})]]
[[AND SOQ.SHIDAT_0 >= {{date_from}}]]
[[AND SOQ.SHIDAT_0 <= {{date_to}}]]
[[AND {{only_open_lines}} = 1
      AND (SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(SOQ.INVQTY_0, 0)) > 0]]
ORDER BY SOQ.SHIDAT_0, SOQ.SOHNUM_0, SOQ.SOPLIN_0

Mapping between the Sage X3 item reference and the supplier's own reference (ITMBPS table). Call it to translate an internal reference into the one to quote on a purchase order, to reconcile a supplier order acknowledgement, invoice or catalogue, or to list everything a supplier references.

Returns SUPPLIER_ITEM_REF (ITMREFBPS_0, the supplier's own reference for the item), ITMREF (the Sage X3 reference), SUPPLIER_DESCRIPTION_ITEM (ITMDESBPS_0,
the wording used by the supplier, often left empty: fall back to x3_item_search for a reliable description), PRIORITY (PIO_0) and MINIMUM_PO_QTY, the minimum quantity accepted by this supplier for this item, expressed in the purchase unit.

PRIORITY ranks the suppliers of one item: the LOWER the value, the higher the priority, so 10 comes before 20. A value of 0 means not filled in, NOT top priority: never present a 0 as the preferred supplier. Priority only makes sense compared across the suppliers of the same item, which requires one call per supplier and a comparison on ITMREF.

One row per item x supplier pair. Reference data only: it states what is referenced and at which rank, never what was ordered or received. For the item setup use x3_item_detail; the sales-side mirror of this tool is x3_customer_item.

Do not add quotes or % around the value: write FR063, not 'FR063' and not %FR063%. Matching is exact, there is no partial search: a truncated code returns an empty result rather than an error, so an empty answer means the code is wrong at least as often as it means the supplier references nothing.

Always pass BPSNUM. Left empty the tool returns the entire table, with no column identifying the supplier, which makes the result unusable.
parameters.sqlQuery:
SELECT 
  ITMREFBPS_0 AS SUPPLIER_ITEM_REF
, ITMREF_0 AS ITMREF
, ITMDESBPS_0 AS SUPPLIER_DESCRIPTION_ITEM
, PIO_0 AS Priority
, PURMINQTY_0 AS Minimum_PO_qty
FROM ITMBPS
WHERE 1 = 1
[[AND BPSNUM_0 = {{BPSNUM}}]]

parameters.toolDescription:
X3_Support — Knowledge base for Sage X3 how-to, configuration, and troubleshooting.

Use this tool to answer questions about how Sage X3 works rather than to act on data. It returns documented explanations, step-by-step procedures, configuration guidance, and error/troubleshooting help for the Sage X3 application (functional setup, parameters, screens, processes, error messages, best practices). Send the user's question as natural-language text. Use it whenever the user asks "how to…", "why…", "what does… mean", "where do I configure…", or reports unexpected behavior or an error message. Do NOT use it to read, list, create, or modify records (use READ/LIST/CREATE/MODIFY for that): X3_Support does not access the user's live data.

Full downstream impact of a purchased component (MFGHEAD + MFGMAT + SORDER): which work orders consume it, which finished item they produce, and which customer order pulls that finished item. One row per component × work order × sales order.

This is the tool for what breaks if this component arrives late. It resolves the whole chain in one call — do NOT chain to x3_sales_order_lines to find the customer, the customer is already here. Use x3_sales_order_lines only for the amount or the full detail of an order flagged as at risk.

OF_DATE_BESOIN_COMPOSANT is the date to compare a new expected receipt date against: a receipt landing after it puts the work order at risk. OF_QTE_BESOIN_COMPOSANT_RESTANT is net of what is already consumed, so a row only appears while the requirement is still open.

OF_QTE_RESTANTE_PF = 0 with a non-zero component requirement is normal, not a data error: the finished item is declared but the component consumption is not yet recorded. A late component cannot block a work order that is already produced.

Always quote the _LIB columns, never the bare codes. Do not add quotes or % around values. Maximum 1000 rows.
parameters.sqlQuery:

    MFM.ITMREF_0                                        AS COMPOSANT,
    MFM.MFGNUM_0                                        AS OF_NUMERO,

    ITVC.PHYSTO_0                                       AS COMPOSANT_STOCK_DISPO,

    MFI.RMNEXTQTY_0                                     AS OF_QTE_RESTANTE_PF,
    ITVP.STOFCY_0                                       AS PF_SITE_STOCK,
    ITVP.PHYSTO_0                                       AS PF_STOCK_DISPO,
    SOQ.SOHNUM_0                                        AS CDE_VENTE,
    SOQ.SOQSTA_0                                        AS CDE_STATUT_LIGNE,
    ISNULL(ML_SST.LANMES_0, '')                         AS CDE_STATUT_LIGNE_LIB,
    SOH.BPCORD_0                                        AS CLIENT,
    SOH.BPCNAM_0                                        AS CLIENT_NOM,
    SOH.CREUSR_0                                        AS CDE_CREATEUR,
    ISNULL(AUS.NOMUSR_0, '')                            AS CDE_CREATEUR_NOM,
    ISNULL(AUS.ADDEML_0, '')                            AS CDE_CREATEUR_EMAIL,
    SOQ.QTY_0                                           AS CDE_QTE_COMMANDEE,
    SOQ.DLVQTY_0                                        AS CDE_QTE_LIVREE,
    SOQ.DLVQTY_0 - SOQ.QTY_0                            AS CDE_QTE_A_LIVRER,
    SOQ.DEMDLVDAT_0                                     AS CDE_DATE_LIV_DEMANDEE
FROM MFGMAT MFM
INNER JOIN MFGHEAD MFG ON MFG.MFGNUM_0 = MFM.MFGNUM_0
INNER JOIN MFGITM MFI ON MFI.MFGNUM_0 = MFM.MFGNUM_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMVT ITVC ON ITVC.ITMREF_0 = MFM.ITMREF_0 AND ITVC.STOFCY_0 = MFM.MFGFCY_0
LEFT JOIN ITMMVT ITVP ON ITVP.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 AND ITVP.STOFCY_0 = MFI.MFGFCY_0
LEFT JOIN SORDERQ SOQ ON SOQ.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 AND SOQ.SOQSTA_0 = 1
LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0
LEFT JOIN AUTILIS AUS ON AUS.USR_0 = SOH.CREUSR_0
LEFT JOIN ATABZON ATZM ON ATZM.CODFIC_0 = 'MFGHEAD' AND ATZM.CODZONE_0 = 'MFGSTA'
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_MST ON ML_MST.LAN_0 = 'FRA' AND ML_MST.LANCHP_0 = ATZM.NOLIB_0 AND ML_MST.LANNUM_0 = MFG.MFGSTA_0
LEFT JOIN ATABZON ATZS ON ATZS.CODFIC_0 = 'SORDERQ' AND ATZS.CODZONE_0 = 'SOQSTA'
LEFT JOIN APLSTD ML_SST ON ML_SST.LAN_0 = 'FRA' AND ML_SST.LANCHP_0 = ATZS.NOLIB_0 AND ML_SST.LANNUM_0 = SOQ.SOQSTA_0
WHERE 1 =1 
[[AND MFM.ITMREF_0 IN ({{item}})]]
[[AND MFM.MFGFCY_0 IN ({{site}})]]
    AND MFG.MFGSTA_0 IN (1, 2) AND (MFM.RETQTY_0 - MFM.USEQTY_0) > 0
ORDER BY MFM.ITMREF_0, MFM.MFGNUM_0, MFI.ITMREF_0

parameters.toolDescription:
THE payment delay entry point (settled due dates only). Averages and counts aggregated on the database side, for customers (receivables) and suppliers (payables).

The level parameter picks the granularity: Total, Site, Partner (customer or supplier ranking), Month (trend), SitePartner, SiteMonth, PartnerMonth, SitePartnerMonth. Always fill it in, otherwise the eight granularities come back mixed together in the same answer. Always fill partner_type too, otherwise customers and suppliers are returned together and must not be added up.

Returns LEVEL, PARTNER_TYPE, YEAR, MONTH, SITE, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER_NAME, DUE_COUNT, AVG_PAYMENT_DAYS, AVG_LATE_DAYS, MAX_LATE_DAYS, LATE_COUNT, LATE_PCT.

Definitions:
- Only due dates that are fully settled are included (amount due minus amount paid = 0). Open or partially paid due dates are excluded, so the result describes past behaviour, not the current outstanding balance.
- The payment date of a due date is the LAST payment date found for it. The month and year of the result are those of the payment date, not of the invoice or the due date.
- PAYMENT_DAYS = payment date minus invoice date (accounting date). It is NULL for entries with no matching invoice (manual entries, for example), and those are ignored by AVG_PAYMENT_DAYS.
- LATE_DAYS = payment date minus due date. Positive = paid late, 0 = paid on the due date, negative = paid early.
- AVG_PAYMENT_DAYS and AVG_LATE_DAYS are simple averages per due date, NOT weighted by amount. LATE_COUNT counts due dates with LATE_DAYS > 0. LATE_PCT = LATE_COUNT / DUE_COUNT x 100.
- Columns outside the requested level are NULL, that is expected.

When to use it: as soon as a payment delay, a late payment rate, a ranking of slow or fast payers (customers) or of paid suppliers, or a trend over time is involved. This tool returns aggregates only, not the document-by-document detail.

Always bound date_from and date_to (they apply to the payment date). Do not add quotes or % around values: the tool handles quoting and wildcards itself. Multi-value parameters take a comma-separated list of raw values (example: FR011,FR012).

Parameters:
- level (required): Granularity of the result. One of Total, Site, Partner, Month, SitePartner, SiteMonth, PartnerMonth, SitePartnerMonth. Month means year + month of the payment date. Always fill it in.
- partner_type (required in practice): Customer for receivables (customer invoices, SINVOICE) or Supplier for payables (supplier invoices, PINVOICE). One value per call, to avoid mixing the two populations.
- date_from (required): Lower bound (inclusive) on the payment date, format YYYY-MM-DD.
- date_to (required): Upper bound (inclusive) on the payment date, format YYYY-MM-DD.
- site: Site (facility) code(s). Comma-separated list accepted. Source: due date site (GACCDUDATE.FCY_0). Leave empty for all sites.
- partner_code: Customer or supplier code(s) (BPR code). Comma-separated list accepted. Leave empty for all partners.
- partner_name: Partner name search, case-insensitive, partial match (LIKE). Pass the raw text only, example: Dupont. Use it when the user gives a name instead of a code.

Warnings to give the user:
- If DUE_COUNT is small (for example below 5) for a row, say the average is not statistically reliable.
- A partner that is both customer and supplier appears under each partner_type separately.
- If the user asks for the amount-weighted delay or for unpaid items (aging), this tool does not answer it: say so.
